summary: Govern publishing through Goal full workflow

delivery.outcome: Require governed Goal full-workflow delivery without allowing implementation publication to bypass pull-request review
nonGoals: No package, registry, tag or GitHub Release publication in this ticket
No weakening of branch protection, exact-head approval or server-side required checks
No claim that historical releases were created through Goal

architecture.decision: Layer Goal delivery modes below the existing PR and trusted-review contract, with a feature probe and phase-specific side-effect limits
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-045 before any dependent release; existing immutable releases and downstream pins remain unchanged

validation.evidence: Publication classes and required Goal full-workflow invocation are asserted
Implementation delivery is PR-only and premature release side effects are forbidden
Feature-probe semantics are present and mapped
The runbook separates the new procedure from immutable historical evidence
Every stable rule is mapped and the exact ticket diff passes the maintained hub contract
